terminated.heading: Interview Terminated
terminated.description: Your interview has been automatically terminated due to multiple violations of the exam integrity rules (navigating away from the window or exiting full-screen).

violationWarning.defaultDescription: Navigating away from the interview screen is being logged as a violation
violationWarning.finalWarning: This is your final warning. One more violation will end your interview.

autoSubmitLoader.messageOffline: Don't worry — your answers are saved. We'll submit automatically when you're back online.
autoSubmitLoader.messageError: {{errorText}} Your answers are saved — please try again.
autoSubmitLoader.messageErrorGenericFallback: Something went wrong submitting your interview.
autoSubmitLoader.messageSuccess: All done! Your results are being prepared now.
autoSubmitLoader.messageSubmitting: Hang tight — we're saving your answers and preparing your results. Please don't close this page.
autoSubmitLoader.waitingOffline: We'll retry automatically when you're back online.
autoSubmitLoader.waitingError: Tap “Try Again” to resubmit. Your progress is safe.
autoSubmitLoader.waitingSubmitting: Please wait, do not close or refresh this page.

tabSwitch.title: Tab Switch Detected
tabSwitch.description: Navigating away from the interview screen is not allowed. Continued violations will end your interview.

fullscreenExit.title: Fullscreen Exit Detected
fullscreenExit.description: Exiting fullscreen is not allowed. Continued violations will end your interview.

fullscreenRestore.title: Fullscreen required
fullscreenRestore.description: Your interview must stay in fullscreen.

windowResize.title: Window Resize Detected
windowResize.description: Resizing or un-maximizing the window is not allowed. Continued violations will end your interview.

noFace.title: Candidate Not Detected
noFace.description: Ensure you are properly positioned in front of the camera.

multipleFaces.title: Multiple People Detected
multipleFaces.description: Only you should be visible on the interview screen. Please ensure no one else is in view.

prohibitedObject.title: Prohibited Device Detected
prohibitedObject.description: Please put away the {{object}} to continue the interview.

notLooking.title: Look at the Camera
notLooking.description: Please keep your eyes on the screen. Looking away repeatedly will be flagged.

eyesClosed.title: Eyes Closed Detected
eyesClosed.description: Please keep your eyes open and stay focused during the interview.

externalDisplay.title: External Display Detected
externalDisplay.description: An external display was detected. Disconnect all external monitors to continue.

screenSharing.title: Screen Sharing Detected
screenSharing.description: Screen sharing or mirroring was detected. Close all sharing apps immediately.

securityMonitor.title: Security Monitor Interrupted
securityMonitor.description: The security monitor was interrupted. This may indicate a tamper attempt.

windowAction.title: Window Action Detected
windowAction.description: The interview window was minimized or closed. Please keep it in focus at all times.

generic.title: Security Violation Detected
generic.description: A security policy violation was detected. Please resolve it immediately.

violationLimit.title: Interview Ended
violationLimit.description: You reached {{violations}} compliance violations. Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

faceMismatch.title: Interview Ended
faceMismatch.description: We could not confirm it was still you on camera. Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

networkDisconnects.title: Interview Ended
networkDisconnects.description: Your connection dropped {{disconnects}} times. Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.

timeExpired.title: Time's Up
timeExpired.description: Your interview time has ended. Your answers have been submitted.

electronSecurity.title: Interview Ended
electronSecurity.description: A security policy violation ended your interview. It has been submitted with the answers you completed.

generic.title: Interview Ended
generic.description: Your interview has been submitted with the answers you completed.
